name: splitBody

versions.rationale: The split refactor for Swift: cuts a body at its middle statement and opens func <name>Rest() there, so the original closing brace closes the new function in the same scope.

docs:
Cuts the body in two at its middle statement: the first half stays, and the rest becomes `func <rest>()` right
after it, in the same scope. Undefined when the body has fewer than `min` statements.
